text: If youapply for an apartment, you might need aSchufareport. Most landlords require it.8This is how you get one.

The Schufa score islike a credit score. A good score shows that you pay your bills on time. The Schufa report (SCHUFA-Bonitätsauskunft) shows your Schufa score (Basisscore). Your score is based on your financial situations. Your income does not affect your score. A score above 95% is good enough.5

section: How to get a Schufa report
text: There are 2 versions of the Schufa:6 Thepaid version(Bonitätsauskunft)It costs €29.95. It looks more official, so landlords prefer it.8You can get it online now (as a PDF), or by post in 1 to 3 days. You must verify your ID document with your phone or computer camera. It works with most passports.13 Thefree version(Datenkopie)It has the same information, but they make it look worse:4It’s harder to read. Your score is mixed with your private information. You must censor it before you share it.7It looks worse. Many landlords want the fancy certificate you get with the paid version.8You get it slower. It arrives by post in 5 to 7 days. It’s harder to read. Your score is mixed with your private information. You must censor it before you share it.7 It looks worse. Many landlords want the fancy certificate you get with the paid version.8 You get it slower. It arrives by post in 5 to 7 days. The paid version is better when youapply for an apartment, because it’s what landlords expect.8The free version is better for your own use. You can also get a Schufa fromImmoScout24. It costs €29.95. If you have apremium membership, you pay 15% to 40% less. It does not work for everyone. You must verify your identity with your bank, and some banks are not supported. TheBonify appshows the same information as the free Schufa report.11The app does not work well, tries to sell you financial products, and is a privacy risk.9I don’t recommend it. You can’t get a Schufa in person at the bank anymore.2

section: How to get a Schufa report
title: If you can’t get a Schufa
text: Short-term apartments (fromHousingAnywhereorSpotahome) rarely require a Schufa. They can help you get your first apartment without a stable job. You can get a Schufa score by opening a bank account. For example, if you open anN26account, you get a Schufa record a few days later.12 Look for short-term apartments

section: How to get a Schufa report
title: If you don’t have a score
text: Schufa is a private company. They only know what other companies tell them. If you are new in Germany, Schufa has no information about you, so you don’t have a score yet.1 You get a Schufa record when you…3 Open a bank account Get a credit card or a loan Get a mobile phone contract Sign up forprivate health insurance Pay for something in instalments Don’t pay your debts When you open a bank account, you let your bank to check your score. If you don’t have a score, a new Schufa record is created. It takes around 7 days.14 Not all companies check your score. Foreign companies rarely care about Schufa. A foreign bank probably won’t create a Schufa record when you open an account.

After you get your Schufa report,look for an apartment. Get afree reportevery year, and check if the information is correct.10False information can lower your Schufa score.
